_about: Public-domain John Wesley (1703-1791, founder of Methodism) for the Word Hoard. Four titles clean from CCEL (Sermons on Several Occasions, Explanatory Notes on the Bible, A Plain Account of Christian Perfection, and the Journal in Percy Livingstone Parker's abridgement, which CCEL transcribed from a 1951 Moody Press reprint and marks Public Domain); and the Works (New York: J. & J. Harper, 10 vols) as raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton scans. His and Charles Wesley's hymns and poems belong to the hymn manifest and stay off. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 8 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
